name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Project Manager | CRM Configuration for Home Services Contractors, Training, AI-Enabled Delivery
summary: Implementation lead who configures business software for contractors and gets them running on it. At Solenzo I build CRM and automation systems for electrical, plumbing, and HVAC businesses: custom workflows and templates, data imports, integrations, and hands-on training for owners and staff. Before that, 15+ years of SaaS implementation: up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and 25+ launches per month at 110% of implementation targets at Wix, partner onboarding with ~94% retention at Birdeye, and sequenced implementation plans for a CRM/PSA platform at Accelo. I use AI on real work every day, from LLM API calls in production workflows to rubric-graded output.

Configure GoHighLevel and HubSpot with custom pipelines, templates, lifecycle stages, and 20+ automated workflows covering lead routing, booking with reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding, and review requests.
Set up and validate data imports and integrations (Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, APIs), debugging technical issues myself.
Use AI on real delivery work: LLM API calls inside workflows, prompt design from client requirements, and rubric-based grading of AI output.
Document every client workflow and configuration in Notion for future reference and support.
